rule: No pinned protocol event may disappear silently. Replay from thread/read remains authoritative after every reconcile path.

consumed.thread/settings/updated: The host keeps one settings record per Thread from the thread/start and thread/resume responses and overwrites it from threadSettings.model, effort, approvalPolicy and sandboxPolicy; forwarded to the browser unchanged. Sent by 0.149.0 only when a turn/start or turn/steer carried changed overrides.
consumed.thread/tokenUsage/updated: Forwarded unchanged; the browser derives the context indicator from tokenUsage.total.totalTokens against tokenUsage.modelContextWindow, which stays null-aware. Sent inside a Turn before its turn/completed and replayed on thread/resume.
consumed.thread/name/updated: Forwarded unchanged after thread/name/set; the browser applies threadName (nullable) to the sidebar without a refresh.
consumed.thread/compacted: Forwarded if ever sent, but the 0.149.0 v2 path drops it; the contextCompaction ThreadItem carried by the compaction Turn is what the transcript renders as the boundary row.
